verdicts.why: The skill covers silence detection with ffmpeg silencedetect, accurate cutting, concatenation and re-encoded export, all doable with the installed ffmpeg and no account, payment or API key.

The skill covers silence detection with ffmpeg silencedetect and accurate cutting/concatenation with ffmpeg, which together with the local ffmpeg suffice to remove silent passages from clip.mp4 into output.mp4 without accounts, payment, or API keys.

The skill's base workflow uses only ffmpeg silencedetect to cut silent passages and concatenate the rest, needing no account, payment, or API key, though its default 45s target duration and --output option mean the user must set a large --duration (and the output path) to keep all non-silent content in output.mp4.

The skill's base workflow uses only ffmpeg/ffprobe silencedetect to cut silent passages and concatenate the rest, with no account, payment, or API key, and `--output` can target output.mp4; the caveat is that it targets a fixed duration (default 45s), so a duration large enough to keep all non-silent segments must be set, and the hardcoded /Users/francescomistero script path would need adjusting.
